primary_comparison: structured_audit minus model_only on identical frozen test cases for each model selected before test evaluation
missing_major: all predictions other than major_validity_failure, including output failures
diagnosis: exact acceptable issue set plus span proxy; explanation correctness requires human assessment
explanation_subset: all pilot major-failure cases; blinded shuffled explanation packets; freeze subset before reading outputs
multiplicity: unadjusted descriptive intervals; future confirmatory family and correction must be frozen before evaluation
